name: carrada_public_backbone_private_transfer
purpose: Transfer the public radar architectures previously evaluated on CARRADA to the private DREAM-BEV radar protocol.

shared_contract.partition: Private Train and Development only; Locked Test is not constructed or read.

provenance.model_suite: Public architecture bodies and training schedule transferred from the CARRADA baseline suite.
provenance.data_layer_change: Only the CARRADA data reader and labels are replaced by the private sequence manifest and frozen metric-BEV reference.
provenance.metric_change: Private common evaluator replaces CARRADA's single-target diagnostic evaluator.
